summary: Gold Royalty Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the acquisition of two net smelter return (NSR) royalties in Nevada from a private seller for total consideration of US$0.8 million. The royalties include a 2.0% NSR on the Sterling property operated by AngloGold Ashanti and a 0.5% NSR on portions of Granite Creek operated by i-80 Gold Corp., with associated advance minimum royalty payments of US$31,500 per year. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The filing also notes second-quarter 2026 earnings release details. No premiums, pricing per share, or structural complexity are disclosed.
